description: The plot illustrates MRR@10 as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S) for four DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10 (ticks shown at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10). The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0 with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. A black solid line with no markers (“DPR w/o query”) is horizontal at roughly 34.25 across all S values. A red solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ corpus expansion”) rises from about 35.15 at S=1 to about 35.55 at S=2, then continues upward more gradually to around 35.78–35.80 by S=7, dips slightly near S=8 (~35.74), and ends near 35.78 at S=10. A green solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers (“DPR w/ document expansion”) starts near 34.78 at S=1, stays close to 34.85–34.90 through S=5, reaches about 34.93 at S=6, then trends slightly downward to about 34.84 by S=10. A blue solid line with star markers (“DPR w/ asymmetric expansion”) begins around 34.75 at S=1, peaks near 35.00 at S=2, fluctuates around 34.65–35.00 through S=8 (including about 35.00 at S=5 and about 34.63 at S=6), and then declines to roughly 34.45 at S=9 and about 34.38 at S=10; the legend appears in the lower-right of the plotting area.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10, with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the 'Number of queries used during inference (S)', using a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows 'MRR@10', also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The first line is 'DPR w/o query' with black, solid, without markers, depicting a constant value of approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The second line is 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', red, with circle markers and a solid style, beginning at an approximate value of 35.1 and increasing steadily to a value of around 36.0 by the x-axis end. The third line is green, with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at about 34.8 and showing a consistent upward trend, ending at around 35.5 at x = 10. The fourth line is blue, with star markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and showing a sharp decline to about 34.0 towards the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
